" "Ensure that System-Assigned Managed Identity is enabled on this Azure Automation Account." ) logger.info("Acquiring Microsoft Graph token via Azure Automation System-Assigned Managed Identity...") headers = {"X-IDENTITY-HEADER": IDENTITY_HEADER, "Metadata": "true"} url_bypass = f"{IDENTITY_ENDPOINT}?resource=https://graph.microsoft.com/&api-version=2019-08-01&bypass_cache=true" url_std = f"{IDENTITY_ENDPOINT}?resource=https://graph.microsoft.com/&api-version=2019-08-01" res = None try: res = requests.get(url_bypass, headers=headers, timeout=25) if res.status_code != 200: res = requests.get(url_std, headers=headers, timeout=25) except Exception: res = requests.get(url_std, headers=headers, timeout=25) res.raise_for_status() token = res.json().get("access_token") if not token: raise RuntimeError("Managed Identity endpoint did not return an access_token.") try: parts = token.split(".") if len(parts) >= 2: payload = parts[1] padded = payload + "=" * (-len(payload) % 4) claims = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(padded).decode("utf-8")) roles = claims.get("roles", []) appid = claims.get("appid", "unknown") logger.info(f"Managed Identity Token Claims -> AppId: {appid}, Roles: {roles}") if "Reports.Read.All" not in roles: logger.warning( f"Reports.Read.All permission not found in current token roles ({roles}). " "Azure Managed Identity endpoint may still be returning a cached token. " "Run: pwsh ./scripts/Grant-GraphPermissions.ps1 -Mi " ) raise content_type = res.headers.get("Content-Type", "") raw_text = res.text.strip() if "application/json" in content_type or raw_text.startswith("{") or raw_text.startswith("["): try: data = res.json() raw_records = data.get("value", data) if isinstance(data, dict) else data return [_normalize_record(r) for r in "#0f172a" bars.append(f'{ds}: {p} prompts, {u} active users') uy = chart_bottom - (u / max_u) * (chart_h - 10) lines.append(f"{xc:.1f},{uy:.1f}") dots.append(f'') if i % 7 == 0 or i == n - 1: try: sd """ def aggregate_metrics(users: List[Dict[str, Any]], period: str = "D28", trend: List[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]: total_users = len(users) active_users = sum(1 for u in users if u["is_active"]) inactive_users = total_users - active_users adoption_rate = round((active_users / total_users * 100), 1) if total_users > 0 else 0.0 total_prompts = sum(u.get("prompts_submitted", 0) for u in users) avg_prompts = round(total_prompts / active_users, 1) if active_users > 0 else 0.0 apps = ["Teams", "Chat", "Outlook", "Word", "Excel", "PowerPoint", "Loop", "OneNote"] app_stats = {} for app in apps: count = sum(1 for u in users if u["app_last_activity"].get(app)) rate = round((count / total_users * 100), 1) if total_users > 0 else 0.0 app_stats[app] = {"active_count": count, "adoption_rate": rate} return { "period": period, "total_users": total_users, "active_users": active_users, "inactive_users": inactive_users, "adoption_rate": adoption_rate, "total_prompts": total_prompts, "avg_prompts": avg_prompts, "app_stats": app_stats, "trend_points": trend or [], "top_users": sorted(users, key=lambda x: (x.get("prompts_submitted", 0), x["total_active_days"]), reverse=True)[:10], "inactive_list": [u for u in users if not u["is_active"]], } def generate_html(metrics: Dict[str, Any]) -> str: app_names = { "Teams": "Microsoft Teams", "Chat": "Business Chat", "Outlook": "Microsoft Outlook", "Word": "Microsoft Word", "Excel": "Microsoft Excel", "PowerPoint": "Microsoft PowerPoint", "Loop": "Microsoft Loop", "OneNote": "Microsoft OneNote", } apps_items = list(metrics["app_stats"].items()) apps_rows = [] for i in range(0, len(apps_items), 2): pair = apps_items[i:i+2] tds = [] for app_name, stats in pair: title = app_names.get(app_name, app_name) rate = stats["adoption_rate"] icon_svg = _render_app_icon(app_name) tds.append(f"""
